profile.ja: 旧井河家を率いた井河長老衆が一角。アサギの父の姉にあたり、権謀術数に長けた人物として知られた。母・葉取星舟に従い、井河家が五車における主導権を握るために暗躍する。対魔殺法の達人で、その実力は井河一門最高の近接戦闘能力と称された桃知東洋にも引けを取らないとされた。毒手使いであったが、切り落とされ、現在はサイボーグ化した鋼鉄の義手を装着している。五車への進攻の際、母に捨て駒とされ、井河アサギに降伏した。
profile.en: She is a member of the Igawa elder group that led the old Igawa family. She is the sister of Igawa Asagi's father and is known as a person skilled in strategy and tactics. Following her mother, Hatori Seishu, she works behind the scenes for the Igawa family to gain control over Gosha. She is a master of Taimanin killing techniques, and her abilities are said to be on par with Momochi Toyo, who is renowned for her exceptional close combat skills. She was a poison user, but her arm was cut off, and she now wears a cybernetic steel prosthetic. During the invasion of Gosha, she was abandoned by her mother and surrendered to Igawa Asagi.

text.ja: どうしたの？　嗤いに来たのかしら？　……わたくしの力が必要？　正気？　……そう、ならこの井河扇舟、再び忍となりましょう
text.en: What's wrong? Did you come to mock me? ... Do you need my power? Are you serious? ... Well, in that case, I, Igawa Senshu, will become a ninja once again.

text.ja: 呆れるわ。いくら降伏したとはいえ五車を危機に陥れた者を部隊に入れるなんて。さすがは魔族も味方につける隊長様と呼んであげましょうか？
text.en: I'm shocked. You're actually considering letting someone who put Gosha in danger join our team? I suppose that's what I'd expect from a captain who can even get demons on our side.

text.ja: わぁ、稲毛屋のアイス！？　懐かしいわね！　……んんっ、い、今のはなかった事にして。あの店の前ではどうしても童心に返ってしまうの
text.en: Wow, Inaguma-ya ice cream! It's been a while! ... Never mind, let's just forget I said that. I always get a little carried away when it comes to that shop.

text.ja: 五車に渦巻く怨念の連鎖は、断ち切れないと思っていたわ。でもあなたはわたくしを許すと言うのね。わたくしに許すよう説いてくれるのね
text.en: I thought the chain of grudges in Gosha would never be broken. But you're saying you'll forgive me, and you'll even try to persuade me to forgive myself.

text.ja: ごめんなさい、この任務資料少し字が小さくて……今何か言ったかしら？　字が小さいのよ、字の方が！　いいから用意しなおして！
text.en: Sorry, this mission briefing has really small text... Did I just say something? The text is tiny, that's what I'm saying! Just redo it for me, okay?

text.ja: この計らいはわたくしの贖罪のためでしょう？　お見通しよ。……そのくらいでどうにかなる罪ではないのに。でもその……いえ何でもないわ
text.en: I suppose this is your way of trying to make amends for my sake? You're perceptive, as always... But it's not something that can be so easily forgiven. Still, I... never mind.

text.ja: あなた、ますますあの目障りな弾正に似てきたわね。……いいえ、今更ふうま家をどうとも思わないわ。ただ、そう……複雑なだけよ
text.en: You're becoming more and more like that annoying Fuuma Danjo. ... No, I don't care about the Fuuma family anymore. It's just... complicated, that's all.

text.ja: あまりに強い憎悪と慕情はとても移ろいやすく、時に並び立つモノよ。ふふ、何の話か分からない？　あなたにはまだ早い話だったかしら？
text.en: Strong hatred and affection can be quite fleeting, and sometimes they can coexist. Hehe, do you have any idea what I'm talking about? Maybe it's still too early for you to understand.

text.ja: ふふ、無様に負けて死に場所すら失った雌犬は性処理肉壺がお似合いね。いいの、そう思わせて。年増を本気にさせないで、後生だから……
text.en: A defeated dog like me, who's lost even her place to die, is only fit to be a sex toy. You're making me think that, aren't you? Don't get me wrong, I'm not taking it seriously... yet.

text.ja: んっ、ちゅ……どうかしら、こっちも少しは自信あるのよ。次はどうして欲しいかしら？　……？　調子が戻って来た？　……もう、意地悪
text.en: Mmm, how's this? I've got a bit of confidence now. What do you want me to do next? ...? Have I gotten too full of myself? ... You're teasing me again.

text.ja: お願い……今だけは“翡翠”と呼んで……言える立場じゃないのは分かっているわ。でもこの時だけは、何物でもないただの娼婦でいたいの
text.en: Please... just call me "Yuri Hisui" for now... I know I'm not in a position to ask for that. But just for this moment, I want to be nothing more than a ordinary prostitute.
